namespace ApplyOptimizerContrasts;

internal sealed record ApplyScenarioBinding(string Name, string Module, string NativeFunctionName);

-module(apply_optimizer_local).
-export([run/1]).
-compile({no_auto_import,[{apply,3}]}).
apply(Mod,Fun,Args)->{local,Mod,Fun,Args}.
run(M)->apply(erlang,call_on_load_function,[M]).

-module(apply_optimizer_probe).
-export([run/3,literal/1,known_list/1,bound_targets/1,unknown_list/3,module_argument/2,targets_arguments/3,item_effect/1,item_throw/1]).
-compile(no_inline).
run(Name,Input,Output)->
    put(output,Output),save("stage.txt",<<"entered">>),
    try
        {ok,B}=file:read_file(Input),P=erlang:prepare_loading(beam_on_load_fresh_success,B),
        {on_load,[beam_on_load_fresh_success]}=erlang:finish_loading([P]),
        term("prepared",P),
        Result=try invoke(Name,beam_on_load_fresh_success) of Value->{value,Value} catch Class:Reason:Stack->{exception,Class,Reason,Stack} end,
        term("actual",Result),text("actual.txt",Result),
        {messages,Messages}=process_info(self(),messages),term("messages",Messages),
        save("stage.txt",<<"completed">>),halt(0)
    catch FailureClass:FailureReason:FailureStack ->term("failure",{FailureClass,FailureReason,FailureStack}),text("failure.txt",{FailureClass,FailureReason,FailureStack}),save("stage.txt",<<"failed">>),halt(3) end.
invoke("literal",M)->literal(M);
invoke("known-list",M)->known_list(M);
invoke("bound-targets",M)->bound_targets(M);
invoke("unknown-list",M)->?MODULE:unknown_list(erlang,call_on_load_function,[M]);
invoke("module-argument",M)->?MODULE:module_argument(erlang,M);
invoke("targets-arguments",M)->?MODULE:targets_arguments(erlang,call_on_load_function,M);
invoke("item-effect",M)->item_effect(M);
invoke("item-throw",M)->item_throw(M);
invoke("local-override",M)->apply_optimizer_local:run(M).
literal(M)->erlang:apply(erlang,call_on_load_function,[M]).
known_list(M)->Args=[M],erlang:apply(erlang,call_on_load_function,Args).
bound_targets(M)->Mod=erlang,Fun=call_on_load_function,Args=[M],erlang:apply(Mod,Fun,Args).
unknown_list(Mod,Fun,Args)->erlang:apply(Mod,Fun,Args).
module_argument(Mod,M)->erlang:apply(Mod,call_on_load_function,[M]).
targets_arguments(Mod,Fun,M)->erlang:apply(Mod,Fun,[M]).
item_effect(M)->erlang:apply(erlang,call_on_load_function,[begin self()!item_evaluated,M end]).
item_throw(M)->erlang:apply(erlang,call_on_load_function,[begin erlang:error(item_failed),M end]).
term(Name,Value)->save(Name++".etf",term_to_binary(Value)).
text(Name,Value)->save(Name,iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format("~tp~n",[Value]))).
save(Name,Bytes)->ok=file:write_file(filename:join(get(output),Name),Bytes).

# Pinned apply optimizer observations

Source-only, unbuilt exporter with nine predeclared observational hypotheses. Each disposable VM stages the exact genuine260 fresh-success image, then probes callback routing without an observer. The existing native257 badmatch,false stack establishes a route signature; this tool does not claim callback lifecycle completion or monitor/DOWN parity. Raw result/complete exception stack, mailbox effects, source, BEAM, disassembly, runtime ETF, build pin, stdout/stderr/exit/stage and hashes are captured before any later comparison. Captured means observation completeness, never semantic pass.

The C# bounded capture implementation is adapted from the repository standalone loader tool into its own namespace. Original code licensing remains the owner's decision; preserved OTP attribution/notices apply to pinned reference reuse. No production/native dependency is introduced. Existing eleven loader and sixteen iodata contracts remain untouched.

Required gates: source peer/freeze before target build; actual raw nonUTF8 and inherited-pipe capture controls, CLI rejection/pin/input/source checks, pinned erlc -Werror compilation and fresh nineVM run, then independent function-specific disassembly/term analysis before compiler broadening. Unknown module/function knownarity shapes remain hypotheses. No SDK expected value is used.

name: Pinned OTP apply optimizer observations
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  fixtures:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v6
        with:
          global-json-file: global.json
      - name: Build standalone optimizer observation tool
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p artifacts
          dotnet build tools/Erlang.ApplyOptimizerContrasts -m:1 --disable-build-servers 2>&1 | tee artifacts/beam-fixture-tool-build.log
      - name: Build and attest the pinned development compiler
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          {
            echo "PINNED_BEAM_SOURCE_BEGIN $GITHUB_SHA"
            git clone --depth 1 --branch OTP-29.1.1 https://github.com/erlang/otp.git artifacts/beam-otp-source
            source_commit="$(git -C artifacts/beam-otp-source rev-parse HEAD)"
            test "$source_commit" = ad05823719d77c8faee87348ea39513d4e2f99c5
            echo "PINNED_BEAM_SOURCE_VERIFIED $source_commit"
            cd artifacts/beam-otp-source
            echo 'PINNED_BEAM_CONFIGURE --without-javac --without-wx --without-odbc --without-debugger --without-observer --without-et'
            ./configure --prefix="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/artifacts/beam-otp-oracle" --without-javac --without-wx --without-odbc --without-debugger --without-observer --without-et
            echo 'PINNED_BEAM_MAKE -j2'
            make -j2
            echo 'PINNED_BEAM_INSTALL'
            make install
            test "$(cat "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/artifacts/beam-otp-oracle/lib/erlang/releases/29/OTP_VERSION")" = 29.1.1
            echo 'PINNED_BEAM_INSTALL_VERIFIED 29.1.1'
          } 2>&1 | tee artifacts/beam-otp-build.log
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import hashlib, json, os, pathlib
          root = pathlib.Path(os.environ['GITHUB_WORKSPACE'])
          log = root / 'artifacts/beam-otp-build.log'
          evidence = {
              'SourceCommit': 'ad05823719d77c8faee87348ea39513d4e2f99c5',
              'SourceTag': 'OTP-29.1.1',
              'SourceBuildCompleted': True,
              'InstalledOtpRoot': str(root / 'artifacts/beam-otp-oracle/lib/erlang'),
              'SourceBuildLog': str(log),
              'SourceBuildLogSha256': hashlib.sha256(log.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper(),
              'HarnessCommit': os.environ['GITHUB_SHA'],
              'RunId': os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ID'],
              'RunAttempt': os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT'],
              'Job': os.environ['GITHUB_JOB'],
              'RunnerOs': os.environ['RUNNER_OS'],
              'ConfigureOptions': ['--without-javac','--without-wx','--without-odbc','--without-debugger','--without-observer','--without-et'],
              'BuildArguments': ['make','-j2'],
              'InstallArguments': ['make','install']
          }
          (root / 'artifacts/beam-source-build-evidence.json').write_text(json.dumps(evidence, indent=2) + '\n')
          PY
      - name: Capture nine optimizer observations in fresh VMs
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          dotnet run --project tools/Erlang.ApplyOptimizerContrasts --no-build -- artifacts/beam-otp-oracle/lib/erlang "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" artifacts/apply-optimizer artifacts/beam-source-build-evidence.json
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        if: always()
        with:
          name: pinned-apply-optimizer
          path: |
            artifacts/apply-optimizer
            artifacts/beam-otp-build.log
            artifacts/beam-source-build-evidence.json
            artifacts/beam-fixture-tool-build.log
